svg.title: Where Mimikai can help: Peru's schools without internet
svg.desc: Map of Peru with its mostly Andean regions highlighted. Peru has 108,239 basic-education services: 54,087 kindergarten, 38,942 primary and 15,210 secondary. About 6 in 10 public primary schools and 3 in 10 public secondary schools have no internet. In 18 regions fewer than half of schools are online; Amazonas 14%, Loreto 18%.
svg.text: Where Mimikai can help: classrooms without internet
Peru first. Shaded: the mostly Andean regions. A class needs no internet, only a projector or TV.
Mostly Andean regions (Cajamarca, Áncash, Huánuco, Pasco, Junín, Huancavelica, Ayacucho, Apurímac, Cusco, Puno)
public primary schools have no internet

Sources: Minedu ESCALE (July 2020) via UNESCO IIEP-SITEAL; Censo Educativo 2023 via Gestión (2 Mar 2024); Minedu via El Comercio (12 Aug 2023).
Boundaries: INEI departments (github.com/juaneladio/peru-geojson), Natural Earth via world-atlas.
